subject: Exception conditions
notes: kb/Work PB75 (2026-08-18) + the F3 PERFORM wave: a fatal condition raised within imperative-statement-1 of an exception-checking PERFORM whose WHEN names it (or a higher level) runs that WHEN's imperative statement (the ambient F3 frame wins over the USE tiers, §14.9.28.4 GR17); after the handler the run unit terminates abnormally unless it RESUMEs (RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT continues after the lowest-level raising statement, §14.9.33.4 GR2a3). ONE dispatch per raise: the PERFORM statement's own guard lets a condition its inner statement already dispatched pass (CobolFatalException.Dispatched) — before, it re-dispatched it to the USE declarative and continued.
